book.name: 2 Abhakoriinto
book.title: Enyaarubha ya kabhiri ya Pauro ku Bhakoriinto

content: Pauro na abheega bho orurimi
Yiingabha ndagaamba kyo omugeege, ndasabha muniitegeerere.
Enye ndabharorera eriihari emwe, eriihari rino rikurwa ku Taatabhugya, kwo obhugazuro muri kyo omuukya wuno atamumenyiri musubhe, wuno niamuyuungiirye omusubhe wumwe, niwe Krisito.
Nawe bhoono ndoobhoha, kyeego Haawa yaangʼeenirwe ne enzoka engʼeeni yirya, na neemwe mutaaza kungʼeenwa, mubhutige obhuseegi bhweenyu bhwe eheene ku Krisito.

Niragaamba ego kwo okubha emwe mbaangu okusuungʼaana omuutu wuno akuuza okurwaaza Yeesu owuundi, wuno etwe tutaamurwaaziri. Kweeki, murasuungʼaana ekoro owuundi kasi amangʼana agaandi, gano mutasuungʼaaniri okurwa kweetwe.
Enye nirarora kubha nitasuuhiirwe kigiro kyokyoosi, kino bhanakyo bhayo bhakwiikora abheega abhakuru.
Naabhe niraarorekane kubha nitakugaamba bhuzomu, nawe obhumenyi bhwaane ni bhukuru. Tweerekirye riyo kweemwe eriibhaga ryoosi na kwe eziinzira zyoosi.
Nikiiyiikya kwe enzira yo okuraarika Amangʼana Amazomu ga Taatabhugya kweemwe okutama kubhona amariho, okubha emwe mukumibhwe. Nikakora kibhi engʼana yiyo?
Eriibhaga nikakora emirimo kweemwe, niari ndasuungʼaana obhusakirya okurwa mumakanisa agaandi. Ni kyeego niari nikubharuusya ebhigiro bhyaabhu, okubha nibhasakirye emwe.

Hano niari hamwe neemwe, nitaari murigo kumuutu wuyo woosi kukusuuhirwa. Abhiikirirya bhano bhaarweereeri Makedonia bhakaaniha bhino niari nikweenda. Kweego nikiiriiha okubha nitabha murigo kweemwe naabhe hasuuhu, kweeki niroongera okwiiriiha.
Atariho omuutu naabhe wumwe mukyaaro kyoosi kya Akaaya, wuno araaniribhire okwiikumya iguru wa amangʼana gayo. Ndagaamba gano kwo obhuheene bhwa Krisito bhuno bhuri muusi waane.
Nitakugaamba ego kwo okubha nitabhaseegiri, Taatabhugya amenyiri kubha ndabhaseega.
Niroongera kukora kyeego nikukora bhoono, okubha abheega bhano bhakubhuga nibho abhakuru, bhatamwe okwiikumya kubha bharakora kyeego etwe.
Abhaatu kya bhayo ni bheega bho orurimi, nibho abhabhagati abhangʼeenererya, bhariikora kya abheega bha Krisito.
Muriyo tutakuruguura, kwe ekigirirye naabhe Seetaani omweene ariikora kyeego maraika
wo obhweero.
Kweego tutakuruguura hano abhahokya bhaaye bhakwiikora kya abhabhagati bhe eheene. Obhuteero bhwaabhu bharasuungʼaana gano gakuriingʼaana ne emirimo gyaabhu.
Pauro ariikumya iguru we enyaako yaaye
Ndabhabhuurira kweeki, omuutu atiiseega kubha enye ni mugeege! Nawe eraabhe muriiseega kubha enye ni mugeege muniitegeerere kyo omugeege, okubha niikumye hasuuhu kyo omugeege yiingiikumirye.
Amangʼana gano nikugaamba bhoono go okwiikumya, nitaheerwe no Omukuru, nawe niragaamba kyo omuutu omugeege.
Abhaaru bhariikumya kwiiguru ya amangʼana ga mukyaaro, kweego, ambe, na enye tiga niikumye.
Emwe kwo okubha muriirora muna amangʼeeni, nikyo mukwiikongʼeererya abhageege kwo obhuzomererwa.

Muriikongʼeererya no okumwiikirirya naabhe omuutu wuno akubhakora kyamuna emwe ni bhagya bhaaye, arabhiibhira no okubhateesya ebhigiro bhyeenyu, kweeki ariirora ni mukuru kukira emwe no okubhatema mubhusyo.

Nirarora eziisoni okugaamba kubha etwe twaari bhanyookobhu bhukongʼu kukora gayo! Bhoono niragaamba kyo omugeege kubha, eraabhe ariho omuutu wuno akweenderwa okwiikumya iguru wa kyokyoosi, na neenye nireenderwa okwiikumya.
Eraabhe ebho ni Abheeburania, na neenye ni Mweeburania. Eraabhe ebho ni Abhiiziraeri, na neenye ni Mwiiziraeri. Eraabhe ebho ni bhe ekisyooko kya Aburahamu,
na neenye ni we ekisyooko kya Aburahamu.

Bhoono nigaambe kyo omuyaanga, eraabhe ebho ni bhahokya bha Krisito, enye ni muhokya wa Krisito kukira ebho. Enye nikoriri omukya kukora emirimo kukiraho, maanga maaru nibhohirwe munyuumba ya abhabhohwa, kweeki nitemirwe bhukongʼu, maanga maaru niari muhabhi ho okukwa.
Nitemirwe na Abhayahudi ebhiteme miroongo etatu na keenda (39), nikorirwe ego maanga kataano.
Nitemirwe eziihiimbo na Abharooma katatu koosi, nitemirwe na amagina rugeendo rumwe, emeeri enisarikiiri katatu koosi, kweeki nikiikara munyaanza obhutiku no omwiisi.

Maanga kaaru, muziingeendo zyaane, niari muhabhi ho okuzoorwa ne ebhitaaro, muhabhi ho okugwaatwa na abhateesya, muhabhi ho okutemwa na Abhayahudi abharikyaane na abhaatu bhano bhatari Abhayahudi. Niari muhabhi mumigye, mwiitirigo na munyaanza. Niari muhabhi ho okunyaakibhwa na bhano bhakwiikora abhiikirirya abharikyeetu.
Nikoriri emirimo mikongʼu gyo okurosya kwiibhaga itaambi, niteengeeziri, ndaambukiri ne enzara, ne enyoota, maanga maaru nihaasiibha no okwiikara muumbeho nitana ngibho zyo okwiisa.
Hamwe na gayo goosi, eziisiku zyoosi nirahizwa ne emirimo gyaane iguru ya amakanisa goosi.
Eraabhe omuutu wumwe ni munyookobhu, na enye niriiyiigwa munyookobhu. Eraabhe omuutu wumwe amugirirye owuundi akore ebhibhi, na neenye nirabha no obhururu.
Eraabhe ereenderwa okwiikumya, niriikumya iguru wo obhunyookobhu bhwaane.
Taatabhugya, Taata wo Omukuru Yeesu Krisito, wuno akweenderwa okukumibhwa kirakeego, amenyiri kubha nitakugaamba orurimi.
Eriibhaga niari mumugye gwa Damesiko, omukaangati wo omugye guno yaari mubhutemi bhwa Areta, akatuura abhariibhi mubhiseku bhyo omugye guyo okubha bhanigwaate.
Nawe abhaatu abharebhe bhakaaniituumya mugusehi kuhitira mwiidirisha rino ryaari munyiki yo omugye, nikahona okugwaatwa.
